note_tweet.text:
I’m slowly cleaning up the suburbs with Muse.

Saw this mess of wires on a pole. Took a picture and asked Muse to contact Verizon to get them cleaned up.

It went to their website and got to work.

There is a 0% chance I would’ve sat in a Verizon support chat over this. I would’ve just been mildly annoyed every time I walked past it for the next five years.

“Someone should do something about that” is now a prompt.

🤝 @alexandr_wang
